title: Content pack manifest
description: Envelope for a body of importable game content.

id.description: Pack namespace prefix. Present in every content id this pack defines. i.e srd-5.2

version.description: Semver. Campaigns pin this so an old campaign resolves the content it was built against.

license.description: SPDX identifier for the terms this pack's content is under. Every pack must declare one so the UI can surface the right notice.

attribution.description: Verbatim attribution notice required by the pack's license. Rendered to end users on the Legal page. Required for CC-BY-4.0 packs.

providesEffectTypes.description: Namespaced effect types this pack introduces

provides.description: Content packs this pack ships. Each entry maps to <name>.json in the pack directory.

modifications.description: How this pack's source material was changed. CC-BY-4.0 s. 3(a)(1)(B) requires indicating modification, and every pack here reformats prose into JSON, so this is required alongside attribution.
